author_note.finding: Faithful user-supplied personal account; own adaptations explicit; no field visit claimed; no promotional call to buy.

findings.issue: Book narrative retains web-series framing: This series follows those choices.
findings.recommendation: Use This book follows those choices in the book-only manuscript. Keep website series wording if appropriate.

findings.issue: The pronoun they grammatically refers to buyers, but the intended limitation concerns what the reports establish.
findings.recommendation: Buyers coming to a farm could shorten the selling journey; these reports do not establish a wider recovery in growers’ earnings.

findings.issue: DKDA, ORMAS, GI and NIFT appear without expansions in the narrative. Readers unfamiliar with Odisha institutions cannot readily distinguish a programme, agency, institution and legal designation.
findings.recommendation: Give verified full names at first occurrence or in the forthcoming glossary, and define GI briefly as geographical indication. Include pucca, bejuni, katri and aal in the glossary without turning local terms into universal or botanical claims.

findings.issue: Adjacent album paragraphs repeat that recordings were not checked. The second instance slows an otherwise clear account of credited work.
findings.recommendation: Retain the album-language qualification in the first paragraph; end the next paragraph with These are his reported instrument names. Preserve the separate Dambu translator/performance qualifications.

findings.issue: Source spellings vary for places and people; an unannounced shift may look like a copy error, especially Chatikona/Chatikana. Existing chapter1 spelling note covers community names only.
findings.recommendation: Add one short editorial convention in glossary or front matter: personal and place-name spellings follow the cited accounts and can vary. Only equate specific variants after source confirmation; do not silently merge Sindhe/Sinde identities or Hiyal Rama/Ram Hial.
